Dream 2026-11-22 linked 8 vignettes from 4 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- undated · touches · "srs as a shared memory is that it is able to provide a decent map of semantic space" (Vignette: sized models, dreamtime as synthetic mapping)
- 2026-10-27 · retells · "any agent should know about current active collections of knowledge" (srs-context should hold the active collections of knowledge, kept light and navigable by dream time (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-27 · touches · "Meaning also has a temporal element. Some information is valuable now, some in the long term." (Navigability is semantic integrity; memory is layered and temporal; the dream cycle builds long-term memory by testing against scenarios (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "build a working, efficient, project level agent memory store that's better than markdown" (srs-context: a project agent memory better than markdown, kept by rule-governed dreams (2026-10-30))
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "This repo should act as our main agent shared memory. It shouldn't really get out of date." (srs-context must be memory agents can trust is current (2026-10-30))
- 2026-10-30 · retells · "Srs-context is intended to be the realtime practical agent memory." (Vignette 2026-10-30: where each kind of meaning lives)
- 2026-10-30 · touches · "Short term and long term memory are different things." (Vignette 2026-10-30: dreamtime is a standard element, short-term and long-term memory differ)
- 2026-11-20 · touches · "we have to have general environments where multiple models can access the same dataset simply" (Vignette 2026-11-20: the baseline argument — wise use of AI needs the right system: layers that make small models native, shared owned data, ownership of meaning, decisions as the semantic act, muDemocracy as the same at group scale)
